item.text: The supplied evidence confirms that projectile locks persist after retreat and that healing can be diverted among patients. I found the unrun Terra v2 revision locally and will assess its exact timeline and lineage before submitting a candidate.

explicit_assumptions: Simulation assumptions: Steward must acquire artillery early enough to kill before retreat at 4440; continuous locks and every in-flight splash may strike the old and neighboring tiles even after retreat or artillery death.
Ansel competes among Fang, Midnight and Steward; Hibiscus competes between Melantha and Vanilla. Their actual heal selection and survival must be observed, not presumed.
Fang and Vanilla living skill income funds the opening; only living retreats refund DP, Steward returns after 2101 frames, and no action relies on a death refund.

Both central blockers must survive and block #28, #31 and #34; returning Steward must kill actual blocked armor before overflow. Midnight and Melantha must clear eastern devices, then their western relay must allow both protected arrivals. All these outcomes are simulation assumptions.

action_timeline.rationale: Correct the 871 shortfall; post-payment balance is 0.033333 conditional on earned income.
Wait for the actually earned 2070 Fang grant; corrected balance is 5.033333.
Requires artillery lethal damage already delivered; leave any born projectile at the vacated eastern tile.

Midnight and Melantha establish outer interception and attack eastern devices.
Ansel and then Hibiscus establish separate medical streams.

Neither income provider dies from lower-impact splash or lane pressure.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Placeholder route; no combat allocation.
Steward kills artillery. Melantha absorbs the intended first lower casts; Ansel sustains upper caster exposure. Track born projectiles independently of source survival.
Midnight clears #3 physically; Steward later clears #1. Track officer hits and actual civilian movement; operators cannot block or heal this neutral target.
Melantha clears #4 and later #2. Require the second civilian to traverse both released passages and reach its objective alive.
Fang supplies upper-central BLOCK. Vanilla and Midnight assist only when their own engagements permit. Steward's central return supplies sustained armor damage.
Vanilla supplies lower-central BLOCK under Hibiscus. Stored Midnight arts must help remove the first armor before runner saturation.
Midnight retains upper-outer blocking throughout all waves. His blocked enemies take precedence over central assistance.
Melantha retains lower-outer interception through the final officer. Her one-block occupancy must clear before another hostile passes.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Upper-central blocking, automatic income and cross-lane attacks when unoccupied.
Lower-central blocking, manual income and cross-lane attacks when unoccupied.
Upper-outer blocking, physical roadblock #3 clearance, then available central arts damage.
Lower-outer blocking, roadblock #4 clearance and initial eastern artillery recipient.
Upper medical stream: Fang, Midnight and eastern Steward.
Lower medical stream: Vanilla and Melantha.
Eastern artillery damage.
After cooldown, damage enemies actually held by both central pioneers.
Final roadblock #1 clearance.
Final roadblock #2 clearance.

artillery_assignment.damage_budget: 45 landed attacks with 36 ordinary hits of 249.1 and nine enhanced hits of 473.29 supply 13227.21 damage.
artillery_assignment.timing_basis: Forty-five uninterrupted 48-frame attacks span 2112 frames after the first hit. Contact interruptions and different enhanced-hit distribution must be accounted for.
artillery_assignment.withdrawal_effect: Withdraw the living caster after lethal damage and before a possible residual impact on his eastern tile. Withdrawal neither cancels a born projectile nor refunds a dead operator.

formation_structure.death_policy: No death is required. Record damage absorbed, damage dealt, income, healing, released enemies, zero death refund and actual redeploy availability. No eighth-ID replacement is authorized.

eastern_devices.limitation: Enemies interrupt device attacks. Neither hit count nor elapsed deployment time proves destruction.
eastern_devices.roadblock_3: Midnight must deliver 27 unboosted 297-damage device hits, or equivalent actual damage, by frame 2700. This deliberately replaces the previous early arts expenditure with a physical-clearance requirement.
eastern_devices.roadblock_4: Melantha must destroy it by frame 3030; her first skill at 2102 can finish any remaining device HP.

economy.conditions: Fang must remain alive and deployed for each automatic grant. Vanilla must remain alive, deployed and skill-ready for each listed activation. Missing income is a survival or execution failure.
economy.redeployment: Inspected current executor charges Steward 18 and Melantha 15 again, with 2100 frames of cooldown after removal. These are current-model costs, not asserted client cost escalation. Refunds can be clipped by the DP cap; death refunds zero.

formation_structure.execution_semantics: The timeline is fixed. Gates are validity assertions, not a conditional action language or permission for Python to retime actions. A failed gate invalidates dependent actions.

medical_geometry.caster_gate: A shell deals 910 to Steward. From full HP, one boosted Ansel heal after that shell leaves only 696.8 HP, insufficient for another shell. Each necessary consecutive-hit recovery interval must contain enough actual healing; two boosted heals suffice. Ansel's attack phase and competing Fang/Midnight injuries remain unverified.
medical_geometry.excluded: Neither stream substitutes for the other. No Ansel extra-heal talent is credited.
medical_geometry.skill_assignment: Ansel's first boost covers frames 2820–3570. It is intended for the first upper shell cluster; readiness does not establish correct heal targeting or cadence.

primary_repair.duty: Require living Fang/Vanilla BLOCK chains. Midnight's stored arts runs from 4381 through approximately 5581, providing first-armor damage before the runner overlap; returning Steward supplies direct central clearance.
primary_repair.enemy: enemy_1110_uamord#21, followed by #22 and the final central runners
primary_repair.limitation: Midnight prioritizes his own blocked enemies. Arts availability is not equivalent to central damage delivered.

revision_from_real_candidate_001.assumptions: Earlier boosted Ansel must deliver enough heals to Steward despite competing upper patients, and earlier Midnight arts must clear device before fatal exposure; survival, income and all passage require simulation.
revision_from_real_candidate_001.changes: No Melantha retreat or lower outer gap; Ansel moves to [2,5] RIGHT; Hibiscus moves to [5,2] RIGHT; Steward moves to [2,7] UP. Ansel boost begins 2072, Midnight uses first arts 1832.
revision_from_real_candidate_001.evidence: Steward died 2593 after four Hibiscus heals; civilian #3 died 3193 before device #3 destruction 3361; officer #16 leaked 4070 with no block.

formation_structure.validation_status: UNSIMULATED; declared opening arithmetic, manual SP intervals and listed range memberships checked read-only

formation_transitions.transition: Complete the four-lane interception formation with an affordable Melantha deployment.
Add western lower medicine after the intended initial Melantha-targeted projectile has been created; recheck acquisition under this opening.
Add Steward using income already earned, completing the seven-unit formation.
Spend Midnight's stored first arts activation on first-armor clearance while retaining upper-outer blocking.
Withdraw Steward only under the asserted artillery-death gate; existing blockers retain every ground lane.
Return Steward centrally after 2101 frames, covering both held queues without releasing either blocker.
After hostile clearance, withdraw Steward; withdraw Melantha one frame later for western device duties.
Deploy Steward west, then Melantha at 11102. Retain the remaining formation until both protected arrivals are observed.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Exactly the seven listed IDs may deploy; all have normal_mode true and rarity 1–3. No reserve-mode units or hidden aliases.
Every deployment uses integer [row,col] and a cardinal direction. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Skills and retreats require the named operator to remain deployed. Death does not authorize an immediate redeploy or a refund.
Use only earned natural DP, executed skill grants and actual living-retreat refunds. Do not advance future grants.
Retain actual BLOCK on all four ground corridors; damage contact is not blocking. Neither central holder may overflow its two slots.
Observe #3 destruction by 2700 and #4 destruction by 3030, then verify civilian positions against every artillery acquisition and impact.
Verify actual HP and heals between successive shells. A nominal healing-per-second total does not satisfy the survival gate.
Artillery must be dead before the fixed 4440 retreat. Resolve all born projectiles without assuming cancellation or movement hold.
Observe live Fang/Vanilla BLOCK on #21/#22 and sufficient actual arts damage or clearance before runner overlap; Midnight skill activation alone is insufficient.
Before cleanup withdrawals, all hostile enemies must be cleared and no hostile projectile may threaten either civilian.

Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two expected protected targets safely reaching their objectives. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Establish all interceptions, preserve both income providers, fund both medics and the caster, and survive the first lower shell exposure.
Complete both eastern devices and verify the actual upper caster heal sequence. Failure of either gate threatens a civilian or the sole artillery damage provider.
Finish artillery lethal damage, begin stored Midnight arts, and account for every outstanding projectile.
Maintain actual central BLOCK and use available Midnight arts to clear first armor before two-block saturation. Survive the caster's real cooldown.
Clear final armor and runners with central Steward; retain all outer interception until hostile clearance.
Complete western device rotations and observe both protected arrivals plus the complete WIN predicate.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic six-DP grants only while alive and continuously deployed.
Manual income and ten-second attack boosts; successive activations allow the active duration plus full inactive recharge.
First arts accelerates upper device clearance; later arts assists armor when available.
Finish lower device damage and shorten outer duels; first activation is recomputed from deployment at 901.
Boost upper caster healing from the first shell; competing patients remain an unverified risk.
Support lower recovery, first armor and final overlap.
Use supported automatic enhanced attacks and highest-defense priority; no manual activation.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Maintain Melantha continuously on the lower outer lane and restore a western lower medic, while moving Steward and Ansel to the upper eastern artillery approach. Start Ansel's healing boost as Steward deploys and use Midnight's first arts to accelerate the upper civilian roadblock. Survival, damage and passage remain simulation assumptions.

candidates.comparison: Restore permanent lower outer hold and shift artillery to upper medical coverage; upper medic contention is unresolved.
First run left the lower outer lane vacant and #16 leaked; seven IDs leave no dedicated replacement.
Extra attacker competes for limited slots and medical protection; preserve device and lane roles.

mechanism_separation.current_model: Artillery has a five-second cast-start cooldown, approximately ten frames to projectile birth, ninety further frames to impact and 1.2 splash radius. Neutral priority precedes operator selection. Ordinary medics heal deployed operators, not civilians.
mechanism_separation.gamedata: Stage movement multiplier is 0.5; artillery raw speed is 0.5 and acquisition radius is 2.0. Roadblocks have 8000 HP, 200 DEF and 20 RES.
mechanism_separation.unknown: Exact client timing and tie-breaks, build equivalence, ordinary roadblock navigation and any artillery movement hold remain unestablished.
mechanism_separation.user_confirmed: Attack baiting, sacrifice and staged retreat are authorized tactical possibilities. Their benefits require a specific expressible attack behavior.

provenance.causal_battle_history: M73 V1–V5 from the supplied registered feedback; their event frames are conditional on their respective structures.
provenance.verification_performed: Read-only source/evidence inspection, declared-ledger arithmetic, range transformation and SP interval checks. No stage simulation or file mutation.

static_conflict_resolution.dependent_skills: Replace the four old Melantha activations with 2102,3903,5704,7505, all after the corrected deployment and full required recharge.
static_conflict_resolution.downstream_recalculation: Once Melantha is actually paid, Steward at 1924 would also be unaffordable. Deploy him at 2071 after Fang's 2070 grant; balance is 5.033333.
static_conflict_resolution.interpretation: These resolve static affordability and readiness declarations, not battle survival.
static_conflict_resolution.melantha: At 871 only 14.033333 DP was available against cost 15. Move deployment to 901, leaving 0.033333.

revised_tactical_requirements.acceptance: Zero leaks, zero protected deaths, two safe protected arrivals and the complete positive-life WIN predicate.
revised_tactical_requirements.clearance: Require artillery lethal damage before 4440 and hostile clearance before 9000; fixed withdrawals are not automatic fallback actions.
revised_tactical_requirements.medical: Record each caster impact, HP before impact, actual heal target and heal time. Reject the survival hypothesis if the required inter-impact recovery is absent.
revised_tactical_requirements.no_mechanic_rewrite: Do not add movement hold, pre-swing lock, enemy reset, unsupported dodge, extra healing, free redeployment or conditional action execution.
revised_tactical_requirements.opening: Observe all four first interceptions and every income provider's survival; do not convert a missing grant into an arithmetic adjustment.
revised_tactical_requirements.primary: Require actual surviving central BLOCK and first-armor clearance before runner overlap, rather than counting range damage as interception.
revised_tactical_requirements.protection: Recompute civilian positions from actual device destruction and their routes. Neither operator bait nor a completed hostile kill overrides neutral priority or a born projectile.
revised_tactical_requirements.static: Resolve the Melantha deployment and all four dependent skill conflicts, and recompute downstream Steward affordability after paying Melantha.

changed_responsibilities: Melantha remains lower outer throughout instead of retreating; Hibiscus heals her from west, and Ansel supports the relocated upper eastern Steward.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Placeholder route; no combat allocation.
Steward kills artillery. Melantha absorbs the intended first lower casts; Ansel sustains upper caster exposure. Track born projectiles independently of source survival.
Midnight clears #3 physically; Steward later clears #1. Track officer hits and actual civilian movement; operators cannot block or heal this neutral target.
Melantha clears #4 and later #2. Require the second civilian to traverse both released passages and reach its objective alive.
Fang supplies upper-central BLOCK. Vanilla and Midnight assist only when their own engagements permit. Steward's central return supplies sustained armor damage.
Vanilla supplies lower-central BLOCK under Hibiscus. Stored Midnight arts must help remove the first armor before runner saturation.
Midnight retains upper-outer blocking throughout all waves. His blocked enemies take precedence over central assistance.
Melantha retains lower-outer interception through the final officer. Her one-block occupancy must clear before another hostile passes.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Upper-central blocking, automatic income and cross-lane attacks when unoccupied.
Lower-central blocking, manual income and cross-lane attacks when unoccupied.
Upper-outer blocking, physical roadblock #3 clearance, then available central arts damage.
Lower-outer blocking, roadblock #4 clearance and initial eastern artillery recipient.
Upper medical stream: Fang, Midnight and eastern Steward.
Lower medical stream: Vanilla and Melantha.
Eastern artillery damage.
After cooldown, damage enemies actually held by both central pioneers.
Final roadblock #1 clearance.
Final roadblock #2 clearance.

artillery_assignment.damage_budget: 45 landed attacks with 36 ordinary hits of 249.1 and nine enhanced hits of 473.29 supply 13227.21 damage.
artillery_assignment.timing_basis: Forty-five uninterrupted 48-frame attacks span 2112 frames after the first hit. Contact interruptions and different enhanced-hit distribution must be accounted for.
artillery_assignment.withdrawal_effect: Withdraw the living caster after lethal damage and before a possible residual impact on his eastern tile. Withdrawal neither cancels a born projectile nor refunds a dead operator.

formation_structure.death_policy: No death is required. Record damage absorbed, damage dealt, income, healing, released enemies, zero death refund and actual redeploy availability. No eighth-ID replacement is authorized.

eastern_devices.limitation: Enemies interrupt device attacks. Neither hit count nor elapsed deployment time proves destruction.
eastern_devices.roadblock_3: Midnight must deliver 27 unboosted 297-damage device hits, or equivalent actual damage, by frame 2700. This deliberately replaces the previous early arts expenditure with a physical-clearance requirement.
eastern_devices.roadblock_4: Melantha must destroy it by frame 3030; her first skill at 2102 can finish any remaining device HP.

economy.conditions: Fang must remain alive and deployed for each automatic grant. Vanilla must remain alive, deployed and skill-ready for each listed activation. Missing income is a survival or execution failure.
economy.redeployment: Inspected current executor charges Steward 18 and Melantha 15 again, with 2100 frames of cooldown after removal. These are current-model costs, not asserted client cost escalation. Refunds can be clipped by the DP cap; death refunds zero.

formation_structure.execution_semantics: The timeline is fixed. Gates are validity assertions, not a conditional action language or permission for Python to retime actions. A failed gate invalidates dependent actions.

medical_geometry.caster_gate: A shell deals 910 to Steward. From full HP, one boosted Ansel heal after that shell leaves only 696.8 HP, insufficient for another shell. Each necessary consecutive-hit recovery interval must contain enough actual healing; two boosted heals suffice. Ansel's attack phase and competing Fang/Midnight injuries remain unverified.
medical_geometry.excluded: Neither stream substitutes for the other. No Ansel extra-heal talent is credited.
medical_geometry.skill_assignment: Ansel's first boost covers frames 2820–3570. It is intended for the first upper shell cluster; readiness does not establish correct heal targeting or cadence.

primary_repair.duty: Require living Fang/Vanilla BLOCK chains. Midnight's stored arts runs from 4381 through approximately 5581, providing first-armor damage before the runner overlap; returning Steward supplies direct central clearance.
primary_repair.enemy: enemy_1110_uamord#21, followed by #22 and the final central runners
primary_repair.limitation: Midnight prioritizes his own blocked enemies. Arts availability is not equivalent to central damage delivered.

revision_from_real_candidate_001.assumptions: Earlier boosted Ansel must deliver enough heals to Steward despite competing upper patients, and earlier Midnight arts must clear device before fatal exposure; survival, income and all passage require simulation.
revision_from_real_candidate_001.changes: No Melantha retreat or lower outer gap; Ansel moves to [2,5] RIGHT; Hibiscus moves to [5,2] RIGHT; Steward moves to [2,7] UP. Ansel boost begins 2072, Midnight uses first arts 1832.
revision_from_real_candidate_001.evidence: Steward died 2593 after four Hibiscus heals; civilian #3 died 3193 before device #3 destruction 3361; officer #16 leaked 4070 with no block.

formation_structure.validation_status: UNSIMULATED; declared opening arithmetic, manual SP intervals and listed range memberships checked read-only

formation_transitions.transition: Complete the four-lane interception formation with an affordable Melantha deployment.
Add western lower medicine after the intended initial Melantha-targeted projectile has been created; recheck acquisition under this opening.
Add Steward using income already earned, completing the seven-unit formation.
Spend Midnight's stored first arts activation on first-armor clearance while retaining upper-outer blocking.
Withdraw Steward only under the asserted artillery-death gate; existing blockers retain every ground lane.
Return Steward centrally after 2101 frames, covering both held queues without releasing either blocker.
After hostile clearance, withdraw Steward; withdraw Melantha one frame later for western device duties.
Deploy Steward west, then Melantha at 11102. Retain the remaining formation until both protected arrivals are observed.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Exactly the seven listed IDs may deploy; all have normal_mode true and rarity 1–3. No reserve-mode units or hidden aliases.
Every deployment uses integer [row,col] and a cardinal direction. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Skills and retreats require the named operator to remain deployed. Death does not authorize an immediate redeploy or a refund.
Use only earned natural DP, executed skill grants and actual living-retreat refunds. Do not advance future grants.
Retain actual BLOCK on all four ground corridors; damage contact is not blocking. Neither central holder may overflow its two slots.
Observe #3 destruction by 2700 and #4 destruction by 3030, then verify civilian positions against every artillery acquisition and impact.
Verify actual HP and heals between successive shells. A nominal healing-per-second total does not satisfy the survival gate.
Artillery must be dead before the fixed 4440 retreat. Resolve all born projectiles without assuming cancellation or movement hold.
Observe live Fang/Vanilla BLOCK on #21/#22 and sufficient actual arts damage or clearance before runner overlap; Midnight skill activation alone is insufficient.
Before cleanup withdrawals, all hostile enemies must be cleared and no hostile projectile may threaten either civilian.

Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two expected protected targets safely reaching their objectives. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Establish all interceptions, preserve both income providers, fund both medics and the caster, and survive the first lower shell exposure.
Complete both eastern devices and verify the actual upper caster heal sequence. Failure of either gate threatens a civilian or the sole artillery damage provider.
Finish artillery lethal damage, begin stored Midnight arts, and account for every outstanding projectile.
Maintain actual central BLOCK and use available Midnight arts to clear first armor before two-block saturation. Survive the caster's real cooldown.
Clear final armor and runners with central Steward; retain all outer interception until hostile clearance.
Complete western device rotations and observe both protected arrivals plus the complete WIN predicate.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic six-DP grants only while alive and continuously deployed.
Manual income and ten-second attack boosts; successive activations allow the active duration plus full inactive recharge.
First arts accelerates upper device clearance; later arts assists armor when available.
Finish lower device damage and shorten outer duels; first activation is recomputed from deployment at 901.
Boost upper caster healing from the first shell; competing patients remain an unverified risk.
Support lower recovery, first armor and final overlap.
Use supported automatic enhanced attacks and highest-defense priority; no manual activation.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Maintain Melantha continuously on the lower outer lane and restore a western lower medic, while moving Steward and Ansel to the upper eastern artillery approach. Start Ansel's healing boost as Steward deploys and use Midnight's first arts to accelerate the upper civilian roadblock. Survival, damage and passage remain simulation assumptions.

candidates.comparison: Restore permanent lower outer hold and shift artillery to upper medical coverage; upper medic contention is unresolved.
First run left the lower outer lane vacant and #16 leaked; seven IDs leave no dedicated replacement.
Extra attacker competes for limited slots and medical protection; preserve device and lane roles.

mechanism_separation.current_model: Artillery has a five-second cast-start cooldown, approximately ten frames to projectile birth, ninety further frames to impact and 1.2 splash radius. Neutral priority precedes operator selection. Ordinary medics heal deployed operators, not civilians.
mechanism_separation.gamedata: Stage movement multiplier is 0.5; artillery raw speed is 0.5 and acquisition radius is 2.0. Roadblocks have 8000 HP, 200 DEF and 20 RES.
mechanism_separation.unknown: Exact client timing and tie-breaks, build equivalence, ordinary roadblock navigation and any artillery movement hold remain unestablished.
mechanism_separation.user_confirmed: Attack baiting, sacrifice and staged retreat are authorized tactical possibilities. Their benefits require a specific expressible attack behavior.

provenance.causal_battle_history: M73 V1–V5 from the supplied registered feedback; their event frames are conditional on their respective structures.
provenance.verification_performed: Read-only source/evidence inspection, declared-ledger arithmetic, range transformation and SP interval checks. No stage simulation or file mutation.

static_conflict_resolution.dependent_skills: Replace the four old Melantha activations with 2102,3903,5704,7505, all after the corrected deployment and full required recharge.
static_conflict_resolution.downstream_recalculation: Once Melantha is actually paid, Steward at 1924 would also be unaffordable. Deploy him at 2071 after Fang's 2070 grant; balance is 5.033333.
static_conflict_resolution.interpretation: These resolve static affordability and readiness declarations, not battle survival.
static_conflict_resolution.melantha: At 871 only 14.033333 DP was available against cost 15. Move deployment to 901, leaving 0.033333.

revised_tactical_requirements.acceptance: Zero leaks, zero protected deaths, two safe protected arrivals and the complete positive-life WIN predicate.
revised_tactical_requirements.clearance: Require artillery lethal damage before 4440 and hostile clearance before 9000; fixed withdrawals are not automatic fallback actions.
revised_tactical_requirements.medical: Record each caster impact, HP before impact, actual heal target and heal time. Reject the survival hypothesis if the required inter-impact recovery is absent.
revised_tactical_requirements.no_mechanic_rewrite: Do not add movement hold, pre-swing lock, enemy reset, unsupported dodge, extra healing, free redeployment or conditional action execution.
revised_tactical_requirements.opening: Observe all four first interceptions and every income provider's survival; do not convert a missing grant into an arithmetic adjustment.
revised_tactical_requirements.primary: Require actual surviving central BLOCK and first-armor clearance before runner overlap, rather than counting range damage as interception.
revised_tactical_requirements.protection: Recompute civilian positions from actual device destruction and their routes. Neither operator bait nor a completed hostile kill overrides neutral priority or a born projectile.
revised_tactical_requirements.static: Resolve the Melantha deployment and all four dependent skill conflicts, and recompute downstream Steward affordability after paying Melantha.

changed_responsibilities: Melantha remains lower outer throughout instead of retreating; Hibiscus heals her from west, and Ansel supports the relocated upper eastern Steward.
revision_hypothesis.if_expected_event_absent: Inspect skill readiness and deployment then classify the roadblock acceleration assumption as unverified.
revision_hypothesis.tactical_hypothesis: Continuous lower interception, earlier upper device arts, and early boosted upper healing may prevent the first candidate's lane leak, civilian death and early caster death.

explicit_assumptions: Simulation assumptions: Steward must acquire artillery early enough to kill before retreat at 4440; continuous locks and every in-flight splash may strike the old and neighboring tiles even after retreat or artillery death.
Ansel competes among Fang, Midnight and Steward; Hibiscus competes between Melantha and Vanilla. Their actual heal selection and survival must be observed, not presumed.
Fang and Vanilla living skill income funds the opening; only living retreats refund DP, Steward returns after 2101 frames, and no action relies on a death refund.

Both central blockers must survive and block #28, #31 and #34; returning Steward must kill actual blocked armor before overflow. Midnight and Melantha must clear eastern devices, then their western relay must allow both protected arrivals. All these outcomes are simulation assumptions.

Revision after candidate-001: Ansel's earlier boost ended before Steward's first 3010 shell; boosted heals from 2950 may cover consecutive shell impacts and permit the roughly 45 landed attacks needed before 4440. This is unverified and patient competition remains decisive.

Wait for the actually earned 2070 Fang grant; corrected balance is 5.033333.
Requires artillery lethal damage already delivered; leave any born projectile at the vacated eastern tile.

Midnight and Melantha establish outer interception and attack eastern devices.
Ansel and then Hibiscus establish separate medical streams.

Upper patients survive until Ansel enters.

battle_phases.goal: Release both eastern civilian passages and sustain artillery damage.
handoff_requirements: Civilian positions leave dangerous eastern acquisition areas.
Steward remains alive and continues the lethal-hit budget.
responsibilities: Midnight clears #3 without spending his stored arts skill.
Melantha clears #4 with available skill damage.
Ansel supplies actual timely caster heals while both central pioneers retain BLOCK.
battle_phases.start_condition: Steward deploys at frame 2071.
survival_dependencies: Civilian officer damage leaves positive HP.
Caster healing meets each impact interval despite competing patients.
Neither income provider dies from lower-impact splash or lane pressure.

battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An alive artillery source at withdrawal breaks the clearance plan; a missing BLOCK chain repeats the #21 failure.
battle_phases.goal: Finish artillery and establish first-armor containment.
handoff_requirements: Record the 9-DP living-retreat refund and 2100-frame cooldown.
Assign all ground enemies to existing blockers; caster withdrawal releases no blocked enemy.
responsibilities: Steward finishes actual lethal damage.
Midnight activates stored arts at 4381.
Fang and Vanilla retain their exact blocking tiles.
battle_phases.start_condition: Eastern protection duties are established and first armor spawns at frame 4380.
survival_dependencies: Steward survives until lethal damage.
Outstanding fixed-point projectiles do not kill civilians or essential operators.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both central holders survive without overflow until Steward returns at 6541.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Any released armor or third enemy passing a saturated holder can leak before later damage repairs the position.
battle_phases.goal: Clear first armor before runner saturation during caster cooldown.
handoff_requirements: Steward returns after the full cooldown at [2,6] UP.
Existing blockers remain deployed while he begins direct queue damage.
responsibilities: Midnight supplies central arts whenever his outer queue permits through approximately 5581.
Both medics preserve their assigned holders.
Outer blockers retain every later officer.
battle_phases.start_condition: Steward is withdrawn after frame 4440.
survival_dependencies: Actual armor damage is sufficient before successive runners consume both central slots.

battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Cleanup rotations would otherwise abandon hostile clearance or expose a protected target.
battle_phases.goal: Clear final armor, runners and outer officers.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Placeholder route; no combat allocation.
Steward kills artillery. Melantha absorbs the intended first lower casts; Ansel sustains upper caster exposure. Track born projectiles independently of source survival.
Midnight clears #3 physically; Steward later clears #1. Track officer hits and actual civilian movement; operators cannot block or heal this neutral target.
Melantha clears #4 and later #2. Require the second civilian to traverse both released passages and reach its objective alive.
Fang supplies upper-central BLOCK. Vanilla and Midnight assist only when their own engagements permit. Steward's central return supplies sustained armor damage.
Vanilla supplies lower-central BLOCK under Hibiscus. Stored Midnight arts must help remove the first armor before runner saturation.
Midnight retains upper-outer blocking throughout all waves. His blocked enemies take precedence over central assistance.
Melantha retains lower-outer interception through the final officer. Her one-block occupancy must clear before another hostile passes.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Upper-central blocking, automatic income and cross-lane attacks when unoccupied.
Lower-central blocking, manual income and cross-lane attacks when unoccupied.
Upper-outer blocking, physical roadblock #3 clearance, then available central arts damage.
Lower-outer blocking, roadblock #4 clearance and initial eastern artillery recipient.
Upper medical stream: Fang, Midnight and eastern Steward.
Lower medical stream: Vanilla and Melantha.
Eastern artillery damage.
After cooldown, damage enemies actually held by both central pioneers.
Final roadblock #1 clearance.
Final roadblock #2 clearance.

artillery_assignment.damage_budget: 45 landed attacks with 36 ordinary hits of 249.1 and nine enhanced hits of 473.29 supply 13227.21 damage.
artillery_assignment.timing_basis: Forty-five uninterrupted 48-frame attacks span 2112 frames after the first hit. Contact interruptions and different enhanced-hit distribution must be accounted for.
artillery_assignment.withdrawal_effect: Withdraw the living caster after lethal damage and before a possible residual impact on his eastern tile. Withdrawal neither cancels a born projectile nor refunds a dead operator.

formation_structure.death_policy: No death is required. Record damage absorbed, damage dealt, income, healing, released enemies, zero death refund and actual redeploy availability. No eighth-ID replacement is authorized.

eastern_devices.limitation: Enemies interrupt device attacks. Neither hit count nor elapsed deployment time proves destruction.
eastern_devices.roadblock_3: Midnight must deliver 27 unboosted 297-damage device hits, or equivalent actual damage, by frame 2700. This deliberately replaces the previous early arts expenditure with a physical-clearance requirement.
eastern_devices.roadblock_4: Melantha must destroy it by frame 3030; her first skill at 2102 can finish any remaining device HP.

economy.conditions: Fang must remain alive and deployed for each automatic grant. Vanilla must remain alive, deployed and skill-ready for each listed activation. Missing income is a survival or execution failure.
economy.redeployment: Inspected current executor charges Steward 18 and Melantha 15 again, with 2100 frames of cooldown after removal. These are current-model costs, not asserted client cost escalation. Refunds can be clipped by the DP cap; death refunds zero.

formation_structure.execution_semantics: The timeline is fixed. Gates are validity assertions, not a conditional action language or permission for Python to retime actions. A failed gate invalidates dependent actions.

medical_geometry.caster_gate: A shell deals 910 to Steward. From full HP, one boosted Ansel heal after that shell leaves only 696.8 HP, insufficient for another shell. Each necessary consecutive-hit recovery interval must contain enough actual healing; two boosted heals suffice. Ansel's attack phase and competing Fang/Midnight injuries remain unverified.
medical_geometry.excluded: Neither stream substitutes for the other. No Ansel extra-heal talent is credited.
medical_geometry.skill_assignment: Ansel's first boost covers frames 2820–3570. It is intended for the first upper shell cluster; readiness does not establish correct heal targeting or cadence.

primary_repair.duty: Require living Fang/Vanilla BLOCK chains. Midnight's stored arts runs from 4381 through approximately 5581, providing first-armor damage before the runner overlap; returning Steward supplies direct central clearance.
primary_repair.enemy: enemy_1110_uamord#21, followed by #22 and the final central runners
primary_repair.limitation: Midnight prioritizes his own blocked enemies. Arts availability is not equivalent to central damage delivered.

revision_from_real_candidate_001.assumptions: Earlier boosted Ansel must deliver enough heals to Steward despite competing upper patients, and earlier Midnight arts must clear device before fatal exposure; survival, income and all passage require simulation.
revision_from_real_candidate_001.changes: No Melantha retreat or lower outer gap; Ansel moves to [2,5] RIGHT; Hibiscus moves to [5,2] RIGHT; Steward moves to [2,7] UP. Ansel boost begins 2072, Midnight uses first arts 1832.
revision_from_real_candidate_001.evidence: Steward died 2593 after four Hibiscus heals; civilian #3 died 3193 before device #3 destruction 3361; officer #16 leaked 4070 with no block.

formation_structure.validation_status: UNSIMULATED; declared opening arithmetic, manual SP intervals and listed range memberships checked read-only

formation_transitions.transition: Complete the four-lane interception formation with an affordable Melantha deployment.
Add western lower medicine after the intended initial Melantha-targeted projectile has been created; recheck acquisition under this opening.
Add Steward using income already earned, completing the seven-unit formation.
Spend Midnight's stored first arts activation on first-armor clearance while retaining upper-outer blocking.
Withdraw Steward only under the asserted artillery-death gate; existing blockers retain every ground lane.
Return Steward centrally after 2101 frames, covering both held queues without releasing either blocker.
After hostile clearance, withdraw Steward; withdraw Melantha one frame later for western device duties.
Deploy Steward west, then Melantha at 11102. Retain the remaining formation until both protected arrivals are observed.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Exactly the seven listed IDs may deploy; all have normal_mode true and rarity 1–3. No reserve-mode units or hidden aliases.
Every deployment uses integer [row,col] and a cardinal direction. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Skills and retreats require the named operator to remain deployed. Death does not authorize an immediate redeploy or a refund.
Use only earned natural DP, executed skill grants and actual living-retreat refunds. Do not advance future grants.
Retain actual BLOCK on all four ground corridors; damage contact is not blocking. Neither central holder may overflow its two slots.
Observe #3 destruction by 2700 and #4 destruction by 3030, then verify civilian positions against every artillery acquisition and impact.
Verify actual HP and heals between successive shells. A nominal healing-per-second total does not satisfy the survival gate.

item.text: The revised boost produced the expected stronger heals, but consecutive 910-damage shells still killed Steward at 3460. The next revision needs to change the shell target or add damage, since timing the same single medic did not sustain the caster.

explicit_assumptions: Simulation assumptions: Steward must acquire artillery early enough to kill before retreat at 4440; continuous locks and every in-flight splash may strike the old and neighboring tiles even after retreat or artillery death.
Ansel competes among Fang, Midnight and Steward; Hibiscus competes between Melantha and Vanilla. Their actual heal selection and survival must be observed, not presumed.
Fang and Vanilla living skill income funds the opening; only living retreats refund DP, Steward returns after 2101 frames, and no action relies on a death refund.

Both central blockers must survive and block #28, #31 and #34; returning Steward must kill actual blocked armor before overflow. Midnight and Melantha must clear eastern devices, then their western relay must allow both protected arrivals. All these outcomes are simulation assumptions.

Revision after candidate-001: Ansel's earlier boost ended before Steward's first 3010 shell; boosted heals from 2950 may cover consecutive shell impacts and permit the roughly 45 landed attacks needed before 4440. This is unverified and patient competition remains decisive.

Revision 3 moves Ansel and Steward south and Hibiscus north while maintaining Melantha; shell lock continuity and splash may hit multiple patients, and target selection, healing, survival and enough artillery damage before frame 4440 are all simulation assumptions. Income, living refunds and #34 blocking remain conditional.

action_timeline.rationale: Correct the 871 shortfall; post-payment balance is 0.033333 conditional on earned income.
Wait for the actually earned 2070 Fang grant; corrected balance is 5.033333.
Requires artillery lethal damage already delivered; leave any born projectile at the vacated eastern tile.

Midnight and Melantha establish outer interception and attack eastern devices.
Ansel and then Hibiscus establish separate medical streams.

Melantha survives until lower medicine begins.
Upper patients survive until Ansel enters.

battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A trapped civilian or lost caster can make artillery clearance and project acceptance unattainable.
battle_phases.goal: Release both eastern civilian passages and sustain artillery damage.
handoff_requirements: Civilian positions leave dangerous eastern acquisition areas.
Steward remains alive and continues the lethal-hit budget.
responsibilities: Midnight clears #3 without spending his stored arts skill.
Melantha clears #4 with available skill damage.
Ansel supplies actual timely caster heals while both central pioneers retain BLOCK.
battle_phases.start_condition: Steward deploys at frame 2071.
survival_dependencies: Civilian officer damage leaves positive HP.
Caster healing meets each impact interval despite competing patients.
Neither income provider dies from lower-impact splash or lane pressure.

battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An alive artillery source at withdrawal breaks the clearance plan; a missing BLOCK chain repeats the #21 failure.
battle_phases.goal: Finish artillery and establish first-armor containment.
handoff_requirements: Record the 9-DP living-retreat refund and 2100-frame cooldown.
Assign all ground enemies to existing blockers; caster withdrawal releases no blocked enemy.
responsibilities: Steward finishes actual lethal damage.
Midnight activates stored arts at 4381.
Fang and Vanilla retain their exact blocking tiles.
battle_phases.start_condition: Eastern protection duties are established and first armor spawns at frame 4380.
survival_dependencies: Steward survives until lethal damage.
Outstanding fixed-point projectiles do not kill civilians or essential operators.

battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Any released armor or third enemy passing a saturated holder can leak before later damage repairs the position.

responsibilities: Midnight supplies central arts whenever his outer queue permits through approximately 5581.
Both medics preserve their assigned holders.
Outer blockers retain every later officer.
battle_phases.start_condition: Steward is withdrawn after frame 4440.
survival_dependencies: Actual armor damage is sufficient before successive runners consume both central slots.

battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Cleanup rotations would otherwise abandon hostile clearance or expose a protected target.
battle_phases.goal: Clear final armor, runners and outer officers.
handoff_requirements: Confirm no hostile or dangerous projectile remains before frames 9000–9001.
Preserve living retreat recipients and record actual refunds.
responsibilities: Steward attacks both held central queues with highest-defense priority.

battle_phases.start_condition: Central Steward deploys at frame 6541.
survival_dependencies: No central overflow occurs before armor dies.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both civilians arrive alive, no active enemies remain, spawns are exhausted, remaining life is positive and leaks remain zero.

responsibilities: Steward destroys #1 from [2,2] DOWN.

Retained operators remain deployed until both distinct protected arrivals are recorded.

Both returning operators satisfy their actual cooldown and cost.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Placeholder route; no combat allocation.
Steward kills artillery. Melantha absorbs the intended first lower casts; Ansel sustains upper caster exposure. Track born projectiles independently of source survival.
Midnight clears #3 physically; Steward later clears #1. Track officer hits and actual civilian movement; operators cannot block or heal this neutral target.
Melantha clears #4 and later #2. Require the second civilian to traverse both released passages and reach its objective alive.
Fang supplies upper-central BLOCK. Vanilla and Midnight assist only when their own engagements permit. Steward's central return supplies sustained armor damage.
Vanilla supplies lower-central BLOCK under Hibiscus. Stored Midnight arts must help remove the first armor before runner saturation.
Midnight retains upper-outer blocking throughout all waves. His blocked enemies take precedence over central assistance.
Melantha retains lower-outer interception through the final officer. Her one-block occupancy must clear before another hostile passes.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Upper-central blocking, automatic income and cross-lane attacks when unoccupied.
Lower-central blocking, manual income and cross-lane attacks when unoccupied.
Upper-outer blocking, physical roadblock #3 clearance, then available central arts damage.
Lower-outer blocking, roadblock #4 clearance and initial eastern artillery recipient.
Upper medical stream: Fang, Midnight and eastern Steward.
Lower medical stream: Vanilla and Melantha.
Eastern artillery damage.
After cooldown, damage enemies actually held by both central pioneers.
Final roadblock #1 clearance.
Final roadblock #2 clearance.

artillery_assignment.damage_budget: 45 landed attacks with 36 ordinary hits of 249.1 and nine enhanced hits of 473.29 supply 13227.21 damage.
artillery_assignment.timing_basis: Forty-five uninterrupted 48-frame attacks span 2112 frames after the first hit. Contact interruptions and different enhanced-hit distribution must be accounted for.
artillery_assignment.withdrawal_effect: Withdraw the living caster after lethal damage and before a possible residual impact on his eastern tile. Withdrawal neither cancels a born projectile nor refunds a dead operator.

formation_structure.death_policy: No death is required. Record damage absorbed, damage dealt, income, healing, released enemies, zero death refund and actual redeploy availability. No eighth-ID replacement is authorized.

eastern_devices.limitation: Enemies interrupt device attacks. Neither hit count nor elapsed deployment time proves destruction.
eastern_devices.roadblock_3: Midnight must deliver 27 unboosted 297-damage device hits, or equivalent actual damage, by frame 2700. This deliberately replaces the previous early arts expenditure with a physical-clearance requirement.
eastern_devices.roadblock_4: Melantha must destroy it by frame 3030; her first skill at 2102 can finish any remaining device HP.

economy.conditions: Fang must remain alive and deployed for each automatic grant. Vanilla must remain alive, deployed and skill-ready for each listed activation. Missing income is a survival or execution failure.
economy.redeployment: Inspected current executor charges Steward 18 and Melantha 15 again, with 2100 frames of cooldown after removal. These are current-model costs, not asserted client cost escalation. Refunds can be clipped by the DP cap; death refunds zero.

formation_structure.execution_semantics: The timeline is fixed. Gates are validity assertions, not a conditional action language or permission for Python to retime actions. A failed gate invalidates dependent actions.

medical_geometry.caster_gate: A shell deals 910 to Steward. From full HP, one boosted Ansel heal after that shell leaves only 696.8 HP, insufficient for another shell. Each necessary consecutive-hit recovery interval must contain enough actual healing; two boosted heals suffice. Ansel's attack phase and competing Fang/Midnight injuries remain unverified.
medical_geometry.excluded: Neither stream substitutes for the other. No Ansel extra-heal talent is credited.
medical_geometry.skill_assignment: Ansel's first boost covers frames 2820–3570. It is intended for the first upper shell cluster; readiness does not establish correct heal targeting or cadence.

primary_repair.duty: Require living Fang/Vanilla BLOCK chains. Midnight's stored arts runs from 4381 through approximately 5581, providing first-armor damage before the runner overlap; returning Steward supplies direct central clearance.
primary_repair.enemy: enemy_1110_uamord#21, followed by #22 and the final central runners
primary_repair.limitation: Midnight prioritizes his own blocked enemies. Arts availability is not equivalent to central damage delivered.

revision_from_real_candidate_001.assumptions: Earlier boosted Ansel must deliver enough heals to Steward despite competing upper patients, and earlier Midnight arts must clear device before fatal exposure; survival, income and all passage require simulation.
revision_from_real_candidate_001.changes: No Melantha retreat or lower outer gap; Ansel moves to [2,5] RIGHT; Hibiscus moves to [5,2] RIGHT; Steward moves to [2,7] UP. Ansel boost begins 2072, Midnight uses first arts 1832.
revision_from_real_candidate_001.evidence: Steward died 2593 after four Hibiscus heals; civilian #3 died 3193 before device #3 destruction 3361; officer #16 leaked 4070 with no block.

formation_structure.validation_status: UNSIMULATED; declared opening arithmetic, manual SP intervals and listed range memberships checked read-only

formation_transitions.transition: Complete the four-lane interception formation with an affordable Melantha deployment.
Add western lower medicine after the intended initial Melantha-targeted projectile has been created; recheck acquisition under this opening.
Add Steward using income already earned, completing the seven-unit formation.
Spend Midnight's stored first arts activation on first-armor clearance while retaining upper-outer blocking.
Withdraw Steward only under the asserted artillery-death gate; existing blockers retain every ground lane.
Return Steward centrally after 2101 frames, covering both held queues without releasing either blocker.
After hostile clearance, withdraw Steward; withdraw Melantha one frame later for western device duties.
Deploy Steward west, then Melantha at 11102. Retain the remaining formation until both protected arrivals are observed.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Exactly the seven listed IDs may deploy; all have normal_mode true and rarity 1–3. No reserve-mode units or hidden aliases.
Every deployment uses integer [row,col] and a cardinal direction. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Skills and retreats require the named operator to remain deployed. Death does not authorize an immediate redeploy or a refund.
Use only earned natural DP, executed skill grants and actual living-retreat refunds. Do not advance future grants.
Retain actual BLOCK on all four ground corridors; damage contact is not blocking. Neither central holder may overflow its two slots.
Observe #3 destruction by 2700 and #4 destruction by 3030, then verify civilian positions against every artillery acquisition and impact.
Verify actual HP and heals between successive shells. A nominal healing-per-second total does not satisfy the survival gate.
Artillery must be dead before the fixed 4440 retreat. Resolve all born projectiles without assuming cancellation or movement hold.
Observe live Fang/Vanilla BLOCK on #21/#22 and sufficient actual arts damage or clearance before runner overlap; Midnight skill activation alone is insufficient.
Before cleanup withdrawals, all hostile enemies must be cleared and no hostile projectile may threaten either civilian.

Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two expected protected targets safely reaching their objectives. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Establish all interceptions, preserve both income providers, fund both medics and the caster, and survive the first lower shell exposure.
Complete both eastern devices and verify the actual upper caster heal sequence. Failure of either gate threatens a civilian or the sole artillery damage provider.
Finish artillery lethal damage, begin stored Midnight arts, and account for every outstanding projectile.
Maintain actual central BLOCK and use available Midnight arts to clear first armor before two-block saturation. Survive the caster's real cooldown.
Clear final armor and runners with central Steward; retain all outer interception until hostile clearance.
Complete western device rotations and observe both protected arrivals plus the complete WIN predicate.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic six-DP grants only while alive and continuously deployed.
Manual income and ten-second attack boosts; successive activations allow the active duration plus full inactive recharge.
First arts accelerates upper device clearance; later arts assists armor when available.
Finish lower device damage and shorten outer duels; first activation is recomputed from deployment at 901.
Boost upper caster healing from the first shell; competing patients remain an unverified risk.
Support lower recovery, first armor and final overlap.
Use supported automatic enhanced attacks and highest-defense priority; no manual activation.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Keep Melantha on the lower outer route as a continuous shell recipient, with Ansel healing both her and lower eastern Steward; Hibiscus supports the upper lane. This moves caster away from observed upper shell focus and relies on a testable lower medical competition.

candidates.comparison: Continuous lower Melantha bait and interception; Ansel supports lower caster and Melantha, upper Hibiscus covers other patients.
Two upper caster exposures ended in Steward death at 3310 and 3460 despite healing.
Earlier withdrawal left a lower lane gap in the prior Terra run.

mechanism_separation.current_model: Artillery has a five-second cast-start cooldown, approximately ten frames to projectile birth, ninety further frames to impact and 1.2 splash radius. Neutral priority precedes operator selection. Ordinary medics heal deployed operators, not civilians.
mechanism_separation.gamedata: Stage movement multiplier is 0.5; artillery raw speed is 0.5 and acquisition radius is 2.0. Roadblocks have 8000 HP, 200 DEF and 20 RES.
mechanism_separation.unknown: Exact client timing and tie-breaks, build equivalence, ordinary roadblock navigation and any artillery movement hold remain unestablished.
mechanism_separation.user_confirmed: Attack baiting, sacrifice and staged retreat are authorized tactical possibilities. Their benefits require a specific expressible attack behavior.

provenance.causal_battle_history: M73 V1–V5 from the supplied registered feedback; their event frames are conditional on their respective structures.
provenance.verification_performed: Read-only source/evidence inspection, declared-ledger arithmetic, range transformation and SP interval checks. No stage simulation or file mutation.

static_conflict_resolution.dependent_skills: Replace the four old Melantha activations with 2102,3903,5704,7505, all after the corrected deployment and full required recharge.
static_conflict_resolution.downstream_recalculation: Once Melantha is actually paid, Steward at 1924 would also be unaffordable. Deploy him at 2071 after Fang's 2070 grant; balance is 5.033333.
static_conflict_resolution.interpretation: These resolve static affordability and readiness declarations, not battle survival.
static_conflict_resolution.melantha: At 871 only 14.033333 DP was available against cost 15. Move deployment to 901, leaving 0.033333.

revised_tactical_requirements.acceptance: Zero leaks, zero protected deaths, two safe protected arrivals and the complete positive-life WIN predicate.
revised_tactical_requirements.clearance: Require artillery lethal damage before 4440 and hostile clearance before 9000; fixed withdrawals are not automatic fallback actions.
revised_tactical_requirements.medical: Record each caster impact, HP before impact, actual heal target and heal time. Reject the survival hypothesis if the required inter-impact recovery is absent.
revised_tactical_requirements.no_mechanic_rewrite: Do not add movement hold, pre-swing lock, enemy reset, unsupported dodge, extra healing, free redeployment or conditional action execution.
revised_tactical_requirements.opening: Observe all four first interceptions and every income provider's survival; do not convert a missing grant into an arithmetic adjustment.
revised_tactical_requirements.primary: Require actual surviving central BLOCK and first-armor clearance before runner overlap, rather than counting range damage as interception.
revised_tactical_requirements.protection: Recompute civilian positions from actual device destruction and their routes. Neither operator bait nor a completed hostile kill overrides neutral priority or a born projectile.
revised_tactical_requirements.static: Resolve the Melantha deployment and all four dependent skill conflicts, and recompute downstream Steward affordability after paying Melantha.

item.text: The lower-route revision exposed an earlier break: Melantha died at frame 2143, and subsequent shells hit both Steward and Ansel. I’m testing a separate lower-healer position to preserve the blocker and change the shell sequence, with caster survival still unresolved.

explicit_assumptions: Simulation assumptions: Steward must acquire artillery early enough to kill before retreat at 4440; continuous locks and every in-flight splash may strike the old and neighboring tiles even after retreat or artillery death.
Ansel competes among Fang, Midnight and Steward; Hibiscus competes between Melantha and Vanilla. Their actual heal selection and survival must be observed, not presumed.
Fang and Vanilla living skill income funds the opening; only living retreats refund DP, Steward returns after 2101 frames, and no action relies on a death refund.

Both central blockers must survive and block #28, #31 and #34; returning Steward must kill actual blocked armor before overflow. Midnight and Melantha must clear eastern devices, then their western relay must allow both protected arrivals. All these outcomes are simulation assumptions.

Revision after candidate-001: Ansel's earlier boost ended before Steward's first 3010 shell; boosted heals from 2950 may cover consecutive shell impacts and permit the roughly 45 landed attacks needed before 4440. This is unverified and patient competition remains decisive.

Revision 3 moves Ansel and Steward south and Hibiscus north while maintaining Melantha; shell lock continuity and splash may hit multiple patients, and target selection, healing, survival and enough artillery damage before frame 4440 are all simulation assumptions. Income, living refunds and #34 blocking remain conditional.

Revision 4 separates lower medic from caster splash and expects actual lower Melantha healing; continuous locks can retarget the unhealed caster, and all artillery kill, patient competition, DP, living retreat, #34 blocking, device and both arrival outcomes remain simulation assumptions.

Wait for the actually earned 2070 Fang grant; corrected balance is 5.033333.
Requires artillery lethal damage already delivered; leave any born projectile at the vacated eastern tile.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Placeholder route; no combat allocation.
Steward kills artillery. Melantha absorbs the intended first lower casts; Ansel sustains upper caster exposure. Track born projectiles independently of source survival.
Midnight clears #3 physically; Steward later clears #1. Track officer hits and actual civilian movement; operators cannot block or heal this neutral target.
Melantha clears #4 and later #2. Require the second civilian to traverse both released passages and reach its objective alive.
Fang supplies upper-central BLOCK. Vanilla and Midnight assist only when their own engagements permit. Steward's central return supplies sustained armor damage.
Vanilla supplies lower-central BLOCK under Hibiscus. Stored Midnight arts must help remove the first armor before runner saturation.
Midnight retains upper-outer blocking throughout all waves. His blocked enemies take precedence over central assistance.
Melantha retains lower-outer interception through the final officer. Her one-block occupancy must clear before another hostile passes.

artillery_assignment.damage_budget: 45 landed attacks with 36 ordinary hits of 249.1 and nine enhanced hits of 473.29 supply 13227.21 damage.
artillery_assignment.timing_basis: Forty-five uninterrupted 48-frame attacks span 2112 frames after the first hit. Contact interruptions and different enhanced-hit distribution must be accounted for.
artillery_assignment.withdrawal_effect: Withdraw the living caster after lethal damage and before a possible residual impact on his eastern tile. Withdrawal neither cancels a born projectile nor refunds a dead operator.

formation_structure.death_policy: No death is required. Record damage absorbed, damage dealt, income, healing, released enemies, zero death refund and actual redeploy availability. No eighth-ID replacement is authorized.

eastern_devices.limitation: Enemies interrupt device attacks. Neither hit count nor elapsed deployment time proves destruction.
eastern_devices.roadblock_3: Midnight must deliver 27 unboosted 297-damage device hits, or equivalent actual damage, by frame 2700. This deliberately replaces the previous early arts expenditure with a physical-clearance requirement.
eastern_devices.roadblock_4: Melantha must destroy it by frame 3030; her first skill at 2102 can finish any remaining device HP.

economy.conditions: Fang must remain alive and deployed for each automatic grant. Vanilla must remain alive, deployed and skill-ready for each listed activation. Missing income is a survival or execution failure.
economy.redeployment: Inspected current executor charges Steward 18 and Melantha 15 again, with 2100 frames of cooldown after removal. These are current-model costs, not asserted client cost escalation. Refunds can be clipped by the DP cap; death refunds zero.

formation_structure.execution_semantics: The timeline is fixed. Gates are validity assertions, not a conditional action language or permission for Python to retime actions. A failed gate invalidates dependent actions.

medical_geometry.caster_gate: A shell deals 910 to Steward. From full HP, one boosted Ansel heal after that shell leaves only 696.8 HP, insufficient for another shell. Each necessary consecutive-hit recovery interval must contain enough actual healing; two boosted heals suffice. Ansel's attack phase and competing Fang/Midnight injuries remain unverified.
medical_geometry.excluded: Neither stream substitutes for the other. No Ansel extra-heal talent is credited.
medical_geometry.skill_assignment: Ansel's first boost covers frames 2820–3570. It is intended for the first upper shell cluster; readiness does not establish correct heal targeting or cadence.

primary_repair.duty: Require living Fang/Vanilla BLOCK chains. Midnight's stored arts runs from 4381 through approximately 5581, providing first-armor damage before the runner overlap; returning Steward supplies direct central clearance.
primary_repair.enemy: enemy_1110_uamord#21, followed by #22 and the final central runners
primary_repair.limitation: Midnight prioritizes his own blocked enemies. Arts availability is not equivalent to central damage delivered.

formation_transitions.transition: Complete the four-lane interception formation with an affordable Melantha deployment.
Add western lower medicine after the intended initial Melantha-targeted projectile has been created; recheck acquisition under this opening.
Add Steward using income already earned, completing the seven-unit formation.
Spend Midnight's stored first arts activation on first-armor clearance while retaining upper-outer blocking.
Withdraw Steward only under the asserted artillery-death gate; existing blockers retain every ground lane.
Return Steward centrally after 2101 frames, covering both held queues without releasing either blocker.
After hostile clearance, withdraw Steward; withdraw Melantha one frame later for western device duties.
Deploy Steward west, then Melantha at 11102. Retain the remaining formation until both protected arrivals are observed.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Exactly the seven listed IDs may deploy; all have normal_mode true and rarity 1–3. No reserve-mode units or hidden aliases.
Every deployment uses integer [row,col] and a cardinal direction. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Skills and retreats require the named operator to remain deployed. Death does not authorize an immediate redeploy or a refund.
Use only earned natural DP, executed skill grants and actual living-retreat refunds. Do not advance future grants.
Retain actual BLOCK on all four ground corridors; damage contact is not blocking. Neither central holder may overflow its two slots.
Observe #3 destruction by 2700 and #4 destruction by 3030, then verify civilian positions against every artillery acquisition and impact.
Verify actual HP and heals between successive shells. A nominal healing-per-second total does not satisfy the survival gate.
Artillery must be dead before the fixed 4440 retreat. Resolve all born projectiles without assuming cancellation or movement hold.
Observe live Fang/Vanilla BLOCK on #21/#22 and sufficient actual arts damage or clearance before runner overlap; Midnight skill activation alone is insufficient.
Before cleanup withdrawals, all hostile enemies must be cleared and no hostile projectile may threaten either civilian.

Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two expected protected targets safely reaching their objectives. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Establish all interceptions, preserve both income providers, fund both medics and the caster, and survive the first lower shell exposure.
Complete both eastern devices and verify the actual upper caster heal sequence. Failure of either gate threatens a civilian or the sole artillery damage provider.
Finish artillery lethal damage, begin stored Midnight arts, and account for every outstanding projectile.
Maintain actual central BLOCK and use available Midnight arts to clear first armor before two-block saturation. Survive the caster's real cooldown.
Clear final armor and runners with central Steward; retain all outer interception until hostile clearance.
Complete western device rotations and observe both protected arrivals plus the complete WIN predicate.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic six-DP grants only while alive and continuously deployed.
Manual income and ten-second attack boosts; successive activations allow the active duration plus full inactive recharge.
First arts accelerates upper device clearance; later arts assists armor when available.
Finish lower device damage and shorten outer duels; first activation is recomputed from deployment at 901.
Boost upper caster healing from the first shell; competing patients remain an unverified risk.
Support lower recovery, first armor and final overlap.
Use supported automatic enhanced attacks and highest-defense priority; no manual activation.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Move Ansel to the western lower pocket to actually reach Melantha and maintain lower interception, avoiding shared splash on the medic and caster. Upper Hibiscus protects the other lane; sustained artillery damage and the caster's independent survival are unverified.

candidates.comparison: Continuous lower Melantha bait and interception; Ansel supports lower caster and Melantha, upper Hibiscus covers other patients.
Two upper caster exposures ended in Steward death at 3310 and 3460 despite healing.
Earlier withdrawal left a lower lane gap in the prior Terra run.

mechanism_separation.current_model: Artillery has a five-second cast-start cooldown, approximately ten frames to projectile birth, ninety further frames to impact and 1.2 splash radius. Neutral priority precedes operator selection. Ordinary medics heal deployed operators, not civilians.
mechanism_separation.gamedata: Stage movement multiplier is 0.5; artillery raw speed is 0.5 and acquisition radius is 2.0. Roadblocks have 8000 HP, 200 DEF and 20 RES.
mechanism_separation.unknown: Exact client timing and tie-breaks, build equivalence, ordinary roadblock navigation and any artillery movement hold remain unestablished.
mechanism_separation.user_confirmed: Attack baiting, sacrifice and staged retreat are authorized tactical possibilities. Their benefits require a specific expressible attack behavior.

provenance.causal_battle_history: M73 V1–V5 from the supplied registered feedback; their event frames are conditional on their respective structures.
provenance.verification_performed: Read-only source/evidence inspection, declared-ledger arithmetic, range transformation and SP interval checks. No stage simulation or file mutation.

static_conflict_resolution.dependent_skills: Replace the four old Melantha activations with 2102,3903,5704,7505, all after the corrected deployment and full required recharge.
static_conflict_resolution.downstream_recalculation: Once Melantha is actually paid, Steward at 1924 would also be unaffordable. Deploy him at 2071 after Fang's 2070 grant; balance is 5.033333.
static_conflict_resolution.interpretation: These resolve static affordability and readiness declarations, not battle survival.
static_conflict_resolution.melantha: At 871 only 14.033333 DP was available against cost 15. Move deployment to 901, leaving 0.033333.

revised_tactical_requirements.acceptance: Zero leaks, zero protected deaths, two safe protected arrivals and the complete positive-life WIN predicate.
revised_tactical_requirements.clearance: Require artillery lethal damage before 4440 and hostile clearance before 9000; fixed withdrawals are not automatic fallback actions.

revised_tactical_requirements.protection: Recompute civilian positions from actual device destruction and their routes. Neither operator bait nor a completed hostile kill overrides neutral priority or a born projectile.

changed_responsibilities: Ansel at [5,2] faces right and covers lower Melantha and Vanilla instead of sharing Steward's splash.

explicit_assumptions: Simulation assumptions: Steward must acquire artillery early enough to kill before retreat at 4440; continuous locks and every in-flight splash may strike the old and neighboring tiles even after retreat or artillery death.
Ansel competes among Fang, Midnight and Steward; Hibiscus competes between Melantha and Vanilla. Their actual heal selection and survival must be observed, not presumed.
Fang and Vanilla living skill income funds the opening; only living retreats refund DP, Steward returns after 2101 frames, and no action relies on a death refund.

Both central blockers must survive and block #28, #31 and #34; returning Steward must kill actual blocked armor before overflow. Midnight and Melantha must clear eastern devices, then their western relay must allow both protected arrivals. All these outcomes are simulation assumptions.

Revision after candidate-001: Ansel's earlier boost ended before Steward's first 3010 shell; boosted heals from 2950 may cover consecutive shell impacts and permit the roughly 45 landed attacks needed before 4440. This is unverified and patient competition remains decisive.

Revision 3 moves Ansel and Steward south and Hibiscus north while maintaining Melantha; shell lock continuity and splash may hit multiple patients, and target selection, healing, survival and enough artillery damage before frame 4440 are all simulation assumptions. Income, living refunds and #34 blocking remain conditional.

Revision 4 separates lower medic from caster splash and expects actual lower Melantha healing; continuous locks can retarget the unhealed caster, and all artillery kill, patient competition, DP, living retreat, #34 blocking, device and both arrival outcomes remain simulation assumptions.

item.text: The western medic arrived too early and was killed by an artillery shell at frame 1571, before the predicted heal. The final candidate will delay that deployment until after the observed early lock and swap the upper medic’s deployment earlier; its survival and targeting remain unverified.

explicit_assumptions: Simulation assumptions: Steward must acquire artillery early enough to kill before retreat at 4440; continuous locks and every in-flight splash may strike the old and neighboring tiles even after retreat or artillery death.
Ansel competes among Fang, Midnight and Steward; Hibiscus competes between Melantha and Vanilla. Their actual heal selection and survival must be observed, not presumed.
Fang and Vanilla living skill income funds the opening; only living retreats refund DP, Steward returns after 2101 frames, and no action relies on a death refund.

Both central blockers must survive and block #28, #31 and #34; returning Steward must kill actual blocked armor before overflow. Midnight and Melantha must clear eastern devices, then their western relay must allow both protected arrivals. All these outcomes are simulation assumptions.

Revision after candidate-001: Ansel's earlier boost ended before Steward's first 3010 shell; boosted heals from 2950 may cover consecutive shell impacts and permit the roughly 45 landed attacks needed before 4440. This is unverified and patient competition remains decisive.

Revision 3 moves Ansel and Steward south and Hibiscus north while maintaining Melantha; shell lock continuity and splash may hit multiple patients, and target selection, healing, survival and enough artillery damage before frame 4440 are all simulation assumptions. Income, living refunds and #34 blocking remain conditional.

Revision 4 separates lower medic from caster splash and expects actual lower Melantha healing; continuous locks can retarget the unhealed caster, and all artillery kill, patient competition, DP, living retreat, #34 blocking, device and both arrival outcomes remain simulation assumptions.

Revision 5 exchanges medic deployment times and shifts skill readiness: the changed formation may change all artillery locks; in-flight shells remain dangerous. No death refund is credited. Conditional income, enough artillery damage before 4440, central block through #34, western redeploy, road clearing and both civilian arrivals require observation.

artillery_assignment.withdrawal_effect: Withdraw the living caster after lethal damage and before a possible residual impact on his eastern tile. Withdrawal neither cancels a born projectile nor refunds a dead operator.

formation_structure.execution_semantics: The timeline is fixed. Gates are validity assertions, not a conditional action language or permission for Python to retime actions. A failed gate invalidates dependent actions.

Each necessary consecutive-hit recovery interval must contain enough actual healing; two boosted heals suffice. Ansel's attack phase and competing Fang/Midnight injuries remain unverified.

medical_geometry.skill_assignment: Ansel's first boost covers frames 2820–3570. It is intended for the first upper shell cluster; readiness does not establish correct heal targeting or cadence.
